Callout.Name: Alleyway Robbery
Callout.Message: Robbery in progress in an alley, caller watching from a window.
Callout.Advisory: One suspect, knife seen, victim still there.

Script.Line: It is the third time this month in that alley.
Two of them, and they took his wallet and his watch.
You can see the whole alley from my window. That is how I watch it.

Lines.Approach: Knife, one suspect, and the victim is still in the alley with them.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
